tips: Keep 100% customer service and interior rating. Happy customers spend up to 20% more without flinching.
Check the market ceiling on your pricing tab - people in Midtown pay top dollar.
Taxes hit every Sunday at midnight. Don't go negative or loan interest will bleed you dry.
Traffic Index matters more than store size. A small 15-capacity store on a 100-traffic corner beats a dead avenue.
Don't hire full-time workers if you're open 8 hours a day. Part-time shifts keep payroll lean.
Commercial real estate is passive gold. Once you own the building, rent expense drops to zero.
Revenue is vanity, profit is sanity, but cash flow is king, kid.

about.title: How the Data Was Extracted
about.subtitle: Big Ambitions Companion does not rely on crowdsourced estimates, guesswork, or third-party wikis. Every pricing formula, customer preference curve, item dimension, and building coordinate is parsed directly from the official Unity game client binaries.
about.stage1Desc: Big Ambitions runs on Unity Engine using C# assemblies (Assembly-CSharp.dll and BigAmbitions.Core.dll). Using ILSpy and runtime reflection, the core business engine, employee scheduling rules, and customer simulation logic were extracted to inspect exact algorithmic calculations rather than approximations.
about.stage2Desc: All items, building footprints, and supplier catalogs are stored as Unity ScriptableObject binary records. These were parsed into structured, type-safe JSON schemas covering all 690 items, 44 business types, 885 real estate parcels, and 62 factory recipes.
about.stage3Desc: Customer price tolerance in Big Ambitions is driven by district demographics and purchasing power distributions. The Companion models these thresholds using baseline wholesale costs, district purchasing power exponents, and experimentally verified price ceiling margins.
about.stage4Desc: The Live HQ mod embeds a lightweight HTTP server on 127.0.0.1:8765. Every half-second, it reads the active in-memory SaveGameManager.Current state and streams your financials, shift schedules, and warehouses locally with zero cloud transmission.
about.section3Intro: The planning calculators throughout the companion implement mathematical models calibrated against game metrics and binary data records. Below are the equations driving each domain:
about.formula1Desc: Calculates maximum profitable retail ceiling before customer elasticity causes refusal to purchase.
about.formula2Desc: Determines hourly customer footfall based on street traffic index, marketing campaigns, and building capacity.
about.formula3Desc: Calculates production cycle duration, component consumption rates, and worker skill batch scaling.
about.privacyDescPrefix: Big Ambitions Companion is an offline-first tool. Telemetry synchronization happens entirely on your local machine via HTTP loopback (
about.privacyDescSuffix: ). No save files, company names, or gameplay metrics are sent to any remote server or external database.

liveArchitecture.badge: Live HQ Bridge Security & Data Pipeline
liveArchitecture.title: How Live Game Synchronization Works
liveArchitecture.intro: The Live HQ bridge establishes a local, zero-cloud connection between your active Big Ambitions session and this web companion. Here is a complete, transparent breakdown of the protocol, safety guarantees, and synchronized payloads.
liveArchitecture.offlineLoopbackDesc: Broadcasts strictly to 127.0.0.1:8765. No game metrics or company names leave your machine.
liveArchitecture.readOnlySafetyDescPrefix: Only samples properties from the active
liveArchitecture.readOnlySafetyDescSuffix: . The embedded server only serves HTTP GET endpoints (zero write operations exist).
liveArchitecture.cpuOverheadDesc: Non-blocking asynchronous serialization every 500ms ensures zero in-game stutter or frame drops.
liveArchitecture.section1Intro: Unlike web tools that require uploading save files to a third-party server, Big Ambitions Companion utilizes a lightweight in-process micro-server embedded inside the game client via the Steam Workshop native mod or standalone MelonLoader plugin.
liveArchitecture.step1Desc: Unity runtime manages active empire state: bank accounts, employee shifts, retail stock, and customer counters.
liveArchitecture.step2DescPrefix: Every 500ms, the mod serializes in-memory game state into a JSON payload on
liveArchitecture.step3Desc: The webapp queries the local port via loopback and renders live 24h shift matrices, P&L charts, and inventory alerts.
liveArchitecture.payload1Desc: Total liquid cash, bank balance, active bank loans, interest rates, tax deductible expenses, and weekly historical revenue/expense figures.
liveArchitecture.payload2Desc: Every employee across all businesses: hourly wage, customer service skill, cleaner skill, security skill, assigned shift hours, and workplace satisfaction.
liveArchitecture.payload3Desc: Warehouse storage box counts, daily consumption drain rates, active delivery routes, vehicle fleet status, and days of stock remaining before stockout.
liveArchitecture.payload4Desc: Store customer counters, hourly traffic profiles, product retail prices, interior customer satisfaction ratings, and owned residential/commercial parcels.
liveArchitecture.safety1DescPrefix: The embedded server only implements HTTP
liveArchitecture.safety1DescSuffix: handlers. There are no POST, PUT, DELETE, or file-write endpoints anywhere in the mod codebase.
liveArchitecture.safety2Desc: The mod never writes to disk. If you uninstall the mod or close the browser, your game save remains 100% vanilla and unmodified.
liveArchitecture.safety3DescSuffix: headers ensure seamless HTTPS-to-localhost communication across Chrome, Edge, Brave, and Firefox.
liveArchitecture.safety4DescPrefix: The complete C# source code is publicly inspectable on GitHub in
liveArchitecture.safety5DescSuffix: . Subscribing via Steam allows Big Ambitions to download and manage the mod assembly natively with zero manual file extraction.

liveArchitecture.verifyDescSuffix: is bound exclusively to local loopback (127.0.0.1 and [::1]) and never exposed to the public network:

districts.title: District Atlas
districts.subtitle: Social-class demographics, real estate multipliers, and price-index baselines for every NYC district.
districts.priceIndexBody: Each social class tolerates a different price ceiling: Working 1.20x, Middle 1.40x, Upper 1.70x the base market price. A district average price index is the share-weighted mean of these.

banking.title: Banking & Investment Guide
banking.subtitle: How loans, daily interest, and investment funds work in Big Ambitions.
banking.banksDesc: Two banks offer loans and investment funds. Visit in person or call them from your Contacts app.
banking.dailyInterestFormula: amount x rate / days per year
banking.dailyInterestNote: Charged on top of the principal payment.
banking.termFormula: years to pay x days per year
banking.termNote: A year is 60 in-game days by default.
banking.minPayment: You may lower the daily payment to a minimum of 50% of the standard amount (still at least $5).
banking.interestMultiplier: Bank interest scales with the difficulty setting via the Bank Interest Multiplier (default 1.0x).
banking.investmentsDesc: Each fund has a range of possible earnings that fluctuates daily. Your balance is the initial deposit plus any extra investment, minus withdrawals, plus accumulated interest.
banking.lowRiskDesc: Almost always earns money, but grows slowly.
banking.highRiskDesc: Can earn faster, but carries a real risk of losing money.
banking.autoInvest: Enable auto-invest to automatically contribute a set amount to a fund. Manage loans and investments from the EconoView app on your BizPhone.

workforce.title: Workforce & Education Compendium
workforce.subtitle: Business school diplomas, employee skills, and how worker skill scales output.
workforce.diplomasDesc: Completed at the Manhattan Business School. Several diplomas gate higher-tier businesses, offices, and factories.
workforce.skillFormulaDesc: A factory worker at 0% skill produces 50% of the base batch. At 100% skill they produce the full amount. Train employees to raise their primary skill and output.
workforce.jobDemandsDesc: Employees request perks and conditions. Fulfill them to keep morale high and prevent them from being poached by rivals.
workforce.demandScheduleDesc: Days per week, time of day, and weekend preferences.
workforce.demandInsuranceDesc: Bronze, silver, or gold coverage plans.
workforce.demandEquipmentDesc: Desks, chairs, monitors, computers, phones, and coffee machines.
workforce.demandEnvironmentDesc: Clean workplaces, peaceful settings, and no cleaning duties.
